thread:
Jess M.: heads up — saw a tiny but consistent mismatch between console and runtime for the `route_priority` flag. console says v2, runtime serving v1 for ~0.2% of requests since 03:10 UTC.
Omar K.: can you paste the exact evidence? e.g. request ids / logs or flag payloads?
Jess M.: pasted a short snippet from runtime /flags API: 
```
GET /internal/flags/route_priority
200 OK
{
  "id": "route_priority",
  "version": "v2",
  "etag": "W/\"42-abc\"",
  "applied_at": "2026-03-21T03:09:04Z"
}
```
but some request traces show `if-none-match` check returning 304 then still using cached local variant v1 (stack tracer attached).
Alex P.: hmm. sounds like local edge process not applying updated payload after 304 — maybe our local cache-update path assumes 200 only.
sre-bot: alert: flag-sync-drift detected (id=route_priority, drift_rate=0.002) — created incident #INC-4821
Omar K.: yeah, code from edge-client: `if response.status == 304: keep_local_value()` — that's probably the bug: we use 304 to mean "no change" but the response etag semantics changed during last console refactor.
Jess M.: proposed quick fix: treat 304 as "verify local etag matches server etag; if mismatch, fetch full payload". Also add a short-circuit metric `flag.sync_check_mismatch` with tags {env, flag, region}.
Alex P.: agree. also add a telemetry gate: if drift_rate > 0.1% for >5m, auto-pause rollouts for that flag and page owners. We should expose that as a console-level toggle (safemode.drift_pause).
Omar K.: implementation plan: 1) patch edge-client to double-check on 304 2) emit `flag.sync_fetch` with reason tag (304_retry) 3) ship canary to eu-west-1 only 4) add grafana panel and an alert rule (for >0.05% over 10m).
Jess M.: i'll open a PR with tests + backfill a small integration harness. example test: simulate server etag mismatch, assert client does a GET and updates cache.
Alex P.: UX note: console should show a small "sync health" pill next to flags (green/yellow/red) with hover explanation and the last mismatch timestamp. Product ok'd minimal UI.
Omar K.: ops runbook snippet for now:
```
# quick fix while patch is rolling
curl -i -H 'If-None-Match: W/"41-xyz"' https://internal/flags/route_priority || true
# if body differs from local store -> restart edge process gracefully
systemctl restart edge-client --no-block
```
Jess M.: will add telemetry event `flag.sync.override` when manual restart happens so we don't hide postmortems.
Alex P.: also check CDN-layer caches (edge-config-proxy) — if it serves stale etags, that could explain distributed 304s.
Omar K.: good call. i'll add a short audit job to scan proxies for inconsistent etags across regions.
Jess M.: action items: PR+tests by EOD, canary deploy 30% in eu-west-1 tomorrow, dashboard tile+alert, add safemode.drift_pause toggle. tagging owners: @Omar K., @Alex P.. thanks all :thumbsup:
Omar K.: I'll add the alert and run the proxy scanner this afternoon.
Alex P.: i'll wire the UI pill with the new metric — dropping a console mock in #product for review.
sre-bot: deployment canary started for edge-client v1.12.3 -> eu-west-1 (33% traffic)
Jess M.: I'll follow up with a short postmortem note once sensors run for 24h.
